protocol.test_policy: one closed phase after source and checkpoint suite freeze
protocol.training: all first-six-day exposures; natural class ratio; Adam or declared candidate optimizer/loss; scratch initialization
protocol.static_snapshot_assumption: Publisher-provided user/ad snapshots treated as static benchmark attributes. Their as-of dates are undocumented; this is not verified production point-in-time data.

context.budget_scope: all preparation, calibration, research calls, failures, controls and final assessment count

knowledge_review.policy: Evaluate relevant external references against local evidence; adoption is optional. Missing source detail and negative transfer remain explicit.
knowledge_review.proposal_output: Add top-level knowledge_assessments: [{knowledge_id, decision: used|considered|rejected|unresolved, rationale, transformed_mechanism, variant_names, nearest_work_difference, falsifier}]. Cover retrieved industry cards; identify the concrete changed mechanism for used cards. This is provenance, not causal proof.
knowledge_review.reflection: Review the latest knowledge-usage.json alongside outcomes; distinguish declared use, executed changes, mechanism evidence and unresolved attribution.

assessments.rationale: No local depth-propagation failure is established. Readout geometry is a different issue; no residual transport, reliability gate or distillation is implemented. Previous use declarations and round-8 failures do not establish or refute CRAFT.
assessments.falsifier: Need authorized local propagation evidence plus a matched replacement to justify a transport claim.

assessments.rationale: Organizer-only detail; no older history beyond frozen 128 or business-domain identities is available. Match partitions are not domains, and group normalization is not dual history compression.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: No history extension, compression or domain exchange.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: No history extension, compression or domain exchange.
assessments.falsifier: Need primary component detail and matched-event compression controls before claiming transfer.

assessments.rationale: No local token-construction bottleneck established; source component detail is organizer-only. Keep current width, feature construction and all parameter allocation.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: No token reallocation, joint projection or decoder.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: No token reallocation, joint projection or decoder.
assessments.falsifier: Need a construction bottleneck and equal-capacity tokenization contrast to revisit.

assessments.rationale: A weak target-query gain in round 7 disappeared under raw magnitude in round 8; this does not establish a query-generation bottleneck. Keep simple inherited queries and a matched history-query replacement.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: No generated probes, field-sequence bridge or multiple views.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: No generated probes, field-sequence bridge or multiple views.
assessments.falsifier: If groupnorm_target fails groupnorm_context, conditioning explanation is unsupported for this branch, not a refutation of QueryFormer.

assessments.rationale: Read primary arxiv:2608.16797v1 lines 685-744: pool/cross-attention overlap and AUC/logloss disagreement in tiny mode. Local global_uniform nearly matches incumbent; raw target also trades AUC for logloss. Report both metrics and retain pooling utility controls.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: No Highway, bus exchange, auxiliary supervision, depth increase or optimizer change.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: No Highway, bus exchange, auxiliary supervision, depth increase or optimizer change.
assessments.falsifier: If geometry gains match history-query controls or disappear across seeds, do not attribute them to target relevance or external interaction paths.

assessments.rationale: Read archived v4 lines 250-277. Local-activation scoring is inherited; source emphasis on intensity motivates distinguishing total from relative group magnitude, but local round-8 AUC decline overrides any assumed transfer.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: Constrain each occupied group contribution to its own mean-pool norm BEFORE mixing while retaining final global norm; 2x2 placement x query factorial. This differs from DIN unnormalized activation weights.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Constrain each occupied group contribution to its own mean-pool norm BEFORE mixing while retaining final global norm; 2x2 placement x query factorial. This differs from DIN unnormalized activation weights.
assessments.falsifier: If groupnorm_target fails globalnorm_target AUC, groupwise constraint utility is unsupported; if context matches it, conditioning is unsupported.

assessments.rationale: Read exact author README lines 1-9; verified category/brand/type without item. Full publisher paper remains unavailable.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: No new DMR module or unavailable item identity.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: No new DMR module or unavailable item identity.
assessments.falsifier: Detailed DMR comparison requires authorized primary full text and implementation audit.

latest_knowledge_usage.limits: A declared source-to-code link is provenance, not a causal estimate of knowledge value or a novelty score.

context.final_assessment_scope: validation only; no test scores or predictions are supplied

reference_format: Use allowed_observation_ids verbatim for local evidence. Descriptive references are accepted when they contain a complete known ID. Correct any previous_runtime_error before submitting; its failed costs remain charged.
action: Read candidate.py and baseline_reference.py, diagnose an observed limitation, check primary nearest work, and implement a feasible candidate. Write proposal.json containing study (matching study_schema), parent_trial (existing trial ID), and variants (1-4 objects with distinct name, file basename ending .py, role candidate/control, config object, and note). At least one candidate is required. Add key ablations or matched controls for the claimed mechanism when feasible; reference existing matched trials as controls where justified. Each variant is a standalone module. Do not run training. New architecture choices come from evidence; industry cards do not mandate them.

candidate_api.Model: Model(meta, config) -> torch.nn.Module; forward(batch) -> finite [B] logits
optional: literal CONFIG dictionary for model dimensions/lr

Model.diagnostics(batch) -> at most 64 named finite scalars; host calls this on the first 512 validation impressions at the frozen best checkpoint, under no_grad. These are candidate-supplied measurements, requiring source-level scrutiny and controls.
candidate_api.ownership: Edit or create only candidate model modules and proposal.json. No filesystem/network access from model code. Numeric imports only: torch,numpy,math,typing,copy,functools,collections,itertools,dataclasses,contextlib.
candidate_api.local_checks: Torch is not installed in the coding jail. Perform syntax/source checks there; host training and scoring follow automatically. Do not install packages or wait for human review.
candidate_api.training: from scratch; fixed host epochs, data, sample coverage, supplied history, scorer and seeds; optional optimizer/loss changes require explicit attribution controls
